text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Now! Go fetch this popcorn!

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uwah?! It caught it in a flash, and in
midair, no
less!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heeeh, impressive, right? I've
trained this
bird to obey any command.
All it took was a ton
of snacks!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now it's my loyal familiar. I even named
it
Boom-Boom! I'm gonna make it into
my new
familiar one day!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: O-ohhh... I see.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I bet you're super jealous, right?
You want
your own familiar, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what gave you that idea? I'm not
jealous
at all! Though it does seem kind
of nice...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That means you are jealous. I'll have you know it's no simple task, unless you're a super smart magical girl like myself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Grrrr... How frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I'm struck by a bolt of
inspiration.
Kawakami's beloved Princess
Fighter is also
accompanied by an animal
mascot...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what are you...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! Trainer, the way you're
speaking—it's just
like Sebastian, the
butler hound from Princess
Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are you—are you saying that you're going to be Kawakami's familiar?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! I can't believe you'd go to
such lengths
for me! I'm so touched, I
can't hold back these
princess tears!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh... whatever! I bet you still can't
catch
popcorn in midair like my loyal
Boom-Boom can!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Says who?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When push comes to shove, Trainer can
do
anything! And that includes catching
midair
popcorn with far more elegance
than you and
your bird!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You're on, then! Let's put your
claim to the
test!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I end up in an unwinnable
showdown
against Sweep Tosho's bird...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! The rules are simple! We'll
both throw
up a piece of popcorn, and
the first minion to
catch their piece is
the victor!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Believe in me. In just a few
moments,
you'll sprout wings that'll take
you soaring
through the air!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Believe! For I will become those wings!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Now, go, Boom-Boom!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's time, Trainer! HRRRYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel Kawakami Princess grab me with
incredible
strength, and the next thing I
know, I'm hurtling
through the air.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The popcorn's right in front of
you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You did it! You did it! What a perfect
catch!
That's my trainer for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was all so fast I'm not quite sure what

happened, but I appear to have caught
the
popcorn.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, you can't throw your familiar!
That's
cheating!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! We're partners! It's only logical
that we'd
work together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And you can't deny that Trainer made a

magnificent catch! I won't listen to your
griping!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer—or rather, Sebastian!
Which
dazzling trick shall we show them
next?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then next, we're going to
engage in
a relay race death match!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! We'll leave you in the dust!
Right,
Boom-Boom?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we continue our showdown until
all the
muscles in my body feel like
they've turned to
jelly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's my Traine—Sebastian!
You're
bursting with competitive spirit!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'm going to send you flying right
up into
the stratosphere! Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: One, two...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A-are you insane?! Your trainer's going
higher
than the academy building!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If today has taught me anything, it's that
I must
never let the heat of the moment
cloud my
judgment again.
